title: Tagalog
blurb: Learn to actually speak Filipino from zero: the sound system, the ang/ng/sa markers that hold every sentence together, pronouns, the verb focus system and aspect, enclitic particles, numbers and time, politeness and family, and the natural Taglish people really speak.
interviewIntro: Situations to answer out loud, with model answers. Read the prompt, say your answer aloud (really aloud: speaking is a different skill from reading), then reveal the model answer and compare.
